simple.meaning: רְבִיעַי (rᵉbîyʻay) is a Hebrew word meaning “fourth.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: רְבִיעַי (H7244) appears 10 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 2:40, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רְבִיעַי (H7244) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in רְבִיעַי (H7244) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: רְבִיעַי (rᵉbîyʻay) / H7244 is traced through Daniel 2:40, Daniel 3:25, Daniel 7:7, Daniel 7:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that crushes all these, it will break in pieces and crush.
